query: SELECT cm.id as moduleId, cm.title as moduleName, cl.id as lessonId, cl.title as lessonTitle, cl.orderIndex, LENGTH(cl.content) as contentLength FROM course_modules cm JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id ORDER BY cm.id, cl.orderIndex;
